intro.en: Share link for the PUFII women's fashion shopping app; the share text mentions no code or offer.

description.zh-TW:
PUFII 帕妃是台灣的女裝品牌，購物 App 可免費下載。

本頁連結是分享文案中的 bmai.app 短網址，沒有邀請碼，是否綁定邀請人未查證。分享文案只寫「推薦你下載 PUFII帕妃 App」，沒有提到優惠，不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
PUFII 帕妃 is a Taiwan women's fashion brand with a shopping app that is free to download.

The link on this page is the bmai.app short link from the share text and it carries no invite code; whether it is tied to a referrer was not checked. The share text only recommends downloading the app and mentions no offer, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有邀請碼與優惠，連結原樣保留。bmai.app 是共用的第三方 App 連結服務，只因網站規則要求才列入，請不要把其他 bmai.app 網址當成 PUFII 官方連結。2026-10-24 以瀏覽器開啟，會轉到 danna.com.tw 的 App 頁面；danna.com.tw 是這個 App 所屬購物網站的網域，App Store 上架頁列為開發者網站。品牌網站 pufii.com.tw 標示的公司名稱，與 App 開發者名稱不同，關係未確認，所以未列入。邀請關係是否被接受，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en: The share text has no invite code and no offer, and the link is kept exactly as shared. bmai.app is a shared third-party app-link service, listed only because the site's rules require it; do not treat other bmai.app links as PUFII official links. Opened in a browser on 2026-10-24, it redirected to an app page on danna.com.tw; danna.com.tw is the domain of this app's shop, named as the developer website on the App Store listing. The brand website pufii.com.tw names a company different from the app's developer; no link between the two was confirmed, and it is not listed. Whether a referral is accepted was not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

a.en: The share text mentions no offer, so none is listed. On 2026-10-24 the app page this link led to showed a first-download promotion for new users; whether it relates to this link was not checked.
